evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We establish convergence guarantees for asynchronous GMC-GRPO and show that, compared with TIC-GRPO, it improves the threshold dependence of the fourth-order delay term from $O(ε^{-4})$ to $O(ε^{-2})$ as $ε\to0$, where $1+ε$ is the ratio threshold.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: Experiments across Qwen3 models and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate improved robustness to stale rollouts, with GMC-GRPO achieving the best performance among stable baselines under large rollout delays.
